howItWorks.title: How It Works
howItWorks.subtitle: A clear process from evaluating your contract until you get paid — with a dedicated case manager at every step
ownerSteps: Enter your contract details and know your initial position — your account is created automatically upon submission.
Contract and payment receipts — we review and verify them.
We verify numbers against documents and prepare a trusted offer for buyers.
We match your unit with qualified buyers ready to continue installments.
We walk with you through transfer procedures step by step until you receive your cash.
buyerSteps: Define your available cash and comfortable installment — your account is set up automatically.
Verified opportunities with complete, transparent numbers.
An official offer with clear terms and full figures.
Every step is documented — payment takes place within the official transfer procedures.
Official developer-approved assignment and a complete file.
howItWorks.commissionTitle: Free for Seller — Clear Commission Structure
howItWorks.commissionDesc: The seller pays zero. The buyer pays 1.25% of the total contract value, strictly when the assignment is successfully completed. If no transfer occurs, nobody pays any commission.
howItWorks.disclaimerBox: We provide estimates based on real documents, but there is no promise of a specific sale duration or guaranteed recovery percentage — results depend on your contract, developer approval, and market demand.

storyPage.heroTitle: Why should anyone lose a huge portion of their money just because they can't continue installments?
storyPage.heroDescription: That question sparked the idea: building a clearer, more humane real estate market that helps you make decisions without pressure or ambiguity, preserving the value of every pound you paid.
storyPage.introP1: It started with a simple observation: many people enter real estate projects with a big dream, but life circumstances sometimes change before that dream is completed.
storyPage.introP2: Delays, new financial commitments, or a sudden need for liquidity. At that moment, the only option is often selling at a heavy loss or waiting endlessly.
storyPage.quote1: How can we exit our installments without losing money? And how do we ensure the contract and transfer process are crystal clear?
storyPage.sec1P1: The problem isn't the property itself — it's the lack of a fair exit path. The buyer needs a clear opportunity, and the seller needs to exit their commitment without losing what they paid.
storyPage.sec1P2: That's why we built a workflow that connects both sides and makes every step transparent.
storyPage.sec1SubTitle: Why not protect the interests of both parties?
storyPage.sec1Card1: The contract owner exits their commitment and recovers 100% of what they paid
storyPage.sec1Card2: And the buyer enters an opportunity at the original contract price with verified data
storyPage.sec2Title: And Thus Aqar Exit Was Born
storyPage.sec2Desc: A platform designed to make buying and selling installment units a clear process — not a race of empty promises or guesswork.
points: You know the exact amount you will receive
Verified numbers and a clear decision
Full respect for everyone's time and effort
storyPage.sec3Title: The Most Important Decision We Made From Day One
storyPage.sec3Desc: We started with a simple question: Can we be fair to both the seller and the buyer at the same time?
storyPage.quote2: We committed ourselves to facilitating transparent exits — never profiting from a unit owner's distress.
storyPage.zeroDesc: Because a fair exit shouldn't cost you extra commission, nor should you pay to recover your own money.
storyPage.sec4Title: For Me... True Value Isn't Just Selling a Unit
storyPage.sec4Desc: True value is exiting your financial commitment while understanding every number, starting your next chapter without regret or loss.
storyPage.quote3: When the decision is clear, all parties can move forward with peace of mind.
storyPage.sec5Title: Our Vision Goes Beyond a Property Listing Site
storyPage.sec5Desc: We are building a data-driven real estate community that respects people's time and opens fair opportunities across the market.
standards: Complete clarity in every step and figure
Fair evaluation based on actual contract documents
A secure platform protecting all parties' rights
storyPage.sec6Title: Ultimately... Aqar Exit is Built on One Idea
storyPage.quote4: A fair market is one where every party can walk away a winner.
storyPage.sec6Desc: The story is just beginning, and every unit owner we help is another step toward a more transparent market.
